results.question: What is total sales by category?
results.ref_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.sales), 2) FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p USING (product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
results.sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(f.sales), 2) AS total_sales FROM fact_sales f JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category

results.question: What is total profit by region?
